items.title: George Henderson Interview, 1961-05-03
items.q: [INTERVIEWEE] Well, Lewis Carter was one of them too.

ctx.x: son. No, but my cousin was friendly. He took me from here to go to Texas. We were friends.
Well, Lewis Carter was one of them too.
Yeah, he was one of them. Dwebne, Arthur Dwebne. Arthur Dwebne, Arthur Dwebne.
